text.body: oṃ tatsadbrāhṛṇe namaḥ oṃ āpyāyantu mamāṅgani vākprāśrcakṣuḥ śrotramatho balamindriyāṇi ca sarvāṇi sarvaṃ brāhṛaupaniṣadaṃ māhaṃ brāhṛ nirākuryāṃ mā mā brāhṛ nirākarodanirākaraṇamastvanirākaraṇaṃ me'stu tadātmani nirate ya upaniṣatsu dharmāste mayi santu te mayi santu| oṃ śāntiḥ śāntiḥ śāntiḥ 'keneṣitam' ityādyopaniṣat parabrāhṛviṣayā vaktavyā iti navamasyādhyāyasya ārambhaḥ| prāgetasmāt karmāṇi aśeṣataḥ parisamāpitāni, samastakarmāśrayabhūtasya ca prāṇasyopāsanānyuktāni, karmāṅgasāmaviṣayāṇi ca| anantaraṃ ca gāyatrasāmaviṣayaṃ darśanaṃ vaṃśāntamuktaṃ kāryam| sarvametadyathoktaṃ karma ca jñānaṃ ca samyaganuṣṭhitaṃ niṣkāmasya mumukṣoḥ sacvaśuddhayarthaṃ bhavati| sakāmasya tu jñānarahitasya kevalāni śrautāni smārtāni ca karmāṇi dakṣiṇamārgapratipattaye punarāvṛttaye ca bhavanti| smābhāvikyā tvaśāstrīyayā pravṛcyā paśvādisthāvarāntā adhogatiḥ syāt| "athaitayoḥ pathorna katareṇa ca na tānimāni kṣudrāṇyasakṛdāvartīni bhūtāni bhavanti jāyasva mriyasvetyetattṛtīyam̐ sthānam" iti śruteḥ ; "prajā ha tistro'tyāyamīyuḥ" iti ca mantravarṇāt| viśuddhasacvasya tu niṣkāmasya eva bāhrādanityāt sādhyasādhanasambandhād iha kṛtātpūrvakṛtāddhā saṃskāraviśeṣobhdavādviraktasya pratyagātmaviṣayā jijñāsā pravartate| tadetadvastu praśnaprativacanalakṣaṇayā śrutyā pradaśryate 'keneṣitam' ityādyayā| kāṭhake coktam "parāñci" khāni vyatṛṇatsvayambhūstasmātparāṅ paśyati nāntarātman| kaściddhīraḥ pratyagātmānamaikṣadāvṛttacakṣuramṛtatvamicchan" ityādi| "parīkṣya lokānkarmacitānbrāāhṛṇo nirvedamāyānnāstyakṛtaḥ kṛtena| tadvijñānārthaṃ sa gurumevābhigacchet samitpāṇiḥ śrottiyaṃ brāhṛniṣṭham" ityādyātharvaṇe ca| evaṃ hi viraktasya pratyagātmaviṣayaṃ vijñānaṃ śrotuṃ mantuṃ vijñātuṃ ca sāmathryamupapadyate, nānyathā| etasmācca pratyagātmabrāhṛvijñānātsaṃsārabījamajñānaṃ kāmakarmapravṛttikāraṇamaśeṣato nivartate, "tatra ko mohaḥ kaḥ śoka ekatvamanupaśyataḥ" iti mantravarṇāt, "tarati śokamātmavit" iti "bhidyate hmadayagranthiśchidyante sarvasaṃśayāḥ| kṣīyante cāsya karmāṇi tasminghṣṭe parāvare" ityādiśrutibhyaśca| karmasahitādapi jñānādetat sidhyatīti cet ? na ; vājasaneyake tasyānyakāraṇatvavacanāt| "jāyā me syāt" iti prastutya "putreṇāyaṃ loko jayyo nānyena karmaṇā, karmaṇā pitṛloko vidyayā devalokaḥ" ityātmano'nyasya lokatrayasya kāraṇatvamuktaṃ vājasaneyake| tatraiva ca pārivrājyavidhāne heturuktaḥ "kiṃ prajayā kariṣyāmo yeṣāṃ no'yamātmāyaṃ lokaḥ" iti| tatrāyaṃ hetvarthaḥ -- prajākarmatatsaṃyuktavidyābhirmanuṣyapitṛdevalokatrayasādhanairanātmalokapratipattikāraṇaiḥ kiṃ kariṣyāmaḥ| na cāsmākaṃ lokatrayamanityaṃ sādhanasādhyamiṣṭam, yeṣāmasmākaṃ svābhāviko'jo'jaro'mṛto'bhayo na vardhate karmaṇā no kanīyānnityaśca loka iṣṭaḥ| sa ca nityatvānnāvidyānivṛttivyatirekeṇānyasādhananiṣpādyaḥ| tasmātpratyagātmabrāhṛvijñānapūrvakaḥ sarvaiṣaṇāsaṃnyāsa eva kartavya iti| karmasahabhāvitvavirodhācca pratyagātmabrāhṛvijñānasya na hrupāttakārakaphalabhedavijñānena karmaṇā pratyastamitasarvabhedadarśanasya pratyagātmabrāhṛviṣayasya sahabhāvitvam upapadyate, vastupradhānye sati apuruṣatantratvād brāhṛvijñānasya| tasmādghṣṭāghṣṭebhyo bāhrasādhanasādhyebhyo viraktasya pratyagātmaviṣayā brāhṛjijñāseyam 'keneṣitam' ityādiśrutyā pradaśryate| śiṣyācāryapraśnaprativacanarūpeṇa kathanaṃ tu sūkṣmavastuviṣayatvāt sukhapratipattikāraṇaṃ bhavati| kevalatarkāgamyatvaṃ ca darśitaṃ bhavati| "naiṣā tarkeṇa matirāpaneyā" iti śruteśca| "ācāryavānpuruṣo veda" "ācāryāddhaiva vidyā viditā sādhiṣṭhaṃ prāpaditi" "tadviddhi praṇipātena" ityādiśrutismṛtiniyamācca kaścid guruṃ brāhṛniṣṭhaṃ vidhivadupetya pratyagātmaviṣayādanyatra śaraṇam apaśyannabhayaṃ nityaṃ śivamacalam icchanpapraccheti kalpyate -- oṃ keneṣitaṃ patati preṣitaṃ manaḥ| kena prāṇaḥ prathamaḥ praiti yuktaḥ| keneṣitāṃ vācamimāṃ vadanti| cakṣuḥ śrotraṃ ka u devo yunakti || 1 || kena iṣitaṃ kena katrrā iṣitam iṣṭamabhipretaṃ sat manaḥ patati gacchati svaviṣayaṃ pratīti sambadhyate iṣerābhīkṣṇyārthasya gatyarthasya cehāsambhavādicchārthasyaivaitadrūpamiti gamyate| iṣitamiti iṭprayogastucchāndasaḥ| tasyaiva prapūrvasya niyogārthe preṣitamityetat| tatra praṣitamityevokte preṣayitṛpreṣaṇaviśeṣaviṣayākāṅkṣā syāt kena preṣayitṛviśeṣeṇa, kīghśaṃ vā preṣaṇamiti| iṣitamiti tu viśeṣaṇe sati tadubhayaṃ nivartate kasyecchāmātreṇa preṣitamityarthaviśeṣanirdhāraṇāt| yadyeṣo'rthe'bhipretaḥ syāt, keneṣitamityetāvataiva siddhatvātpreṣitamiti icchayā karmaṇā vācā vā kena preṣitamityarthaviśeṣo'vagantuṃ yuktaḥ| na, praśnasāmathryāt, dehādisaṃdyātādanityātkarmakāryādviraktaḥ ato'nyatkūṭasthaṃ nityaṃ vastu bubhutsamānaḥ pṛcchatīti sāmathryādupapadyate| itarathā icchāvākkarmabhirdehādisaṃdyātasya prerayitṛtvaṃ prasiddhamiti praśno'narthaka eva syāt| evamapi preṣitaśabdasyārtho na pradarśita eva| na ; saṃśayavato'yaṃ praśna iti preṣitaśabdasyārthaviśeṣa upapadyate| kiṃ yathāprasiddhameva kāryakaraṇasaṃdyātasya preṣayitṛtvam, kiṃ vā saṃdyātavyatiriktasya svatantrasya icchāmātreṇaiva manaādipreṣayitṛtvam, ityasyārthasya pradarśanārtha yeneṣitaṃ patati preṣitaṃ mana iti viśeṣaṇadvayamupapadyate| nanu svatantraṃ manaḥ svaviṣaye svayaṃ patatīti prasiddham ; tatra kathaṃ praśna upapadyata iti, ucyate -- yadi svatantraṃ manaḥ pravṛttinivṛttiviṣaye syāt, tarhi sarvasya aniṣṭacintanaṃ na syāt| anarthaṃ ca jānansaṅkalpayati| abhyagraduḥkhe ca kārye vāryamāṇamapi pravartata eva manaḥ| tasmādyukta eva keneṣitamityādi praśnaḥ| kena prāṇaḥ yuktaḥ niyuktaḥ preritaḥ san preti gacchati svavyāpāraṃ prati| prathama iti prāṇaviśeṣaṇaṃ syāt tatpūrvakatvāt sarvendriyapravṛttīnām| kena iṣitāṃ vācam imāṃ śabdalakṣaṇāṃ vadanti laukikāḥ| tathā cakṣuḥ śrotraṃ ca sve sve viṣaye ka u devaḥ ghotanavān yunakti niyuṅkte prerayati || 1 || evaṃ pṛṣṭavate yogyāyāha guruḥ| śrṛṇu yat tvaṃ pṛcchasi, manaādikaraṇajātasya ko devaḥ svaviṣayaṃ prati prerayitā kathaṃ vā prerayatīti| śrotrasya śrotraṃ manaso mano yadvaco ha vācaṃ sa u prāṇasya prāṇaścakṣuṣaścakṣuratimucya dhīrāḥ pretyāsmāllokādamṛtā bhavinti ||2|| śrotrasya śrotraṃ śrṛṇotyaneneti śrotram śabdasya śravaṇaṃ prati karaṇaṃ śabdābhivyañjakaṃ śrotramindriyam tasya śrotraṃ saḥ yastvayā pṛṣṭaḥ 'cakṣuḥ śrotraṃ kau devo yunakti' iti| asāvevaṃviśiṣṭaḥ śrotrādīni niyuṅkta iti vaktavye, nanvetadananurūpaṃ prativacanaṃ śrotrasya śrotrasiti| naiṣa doṣaḥ tasyānyathā viśeṣānavagamāt| yadi hi śrotrādivyāpāravyatiriktena svavyāpāreṇa viśiṣṭaḥ śrotrādiniyoktā avagamyeta dātrādiprayoktṛvat, tadetamananurūpaṃ prativacanaṃ syāt| na tviha śrotrādīnāṃ prayoktā svavyāpāraviśiṣṭo lavitrādivadadhigamyate| śrotrādīnāmeva tu saṃhatānāṃ vyāpāreṇālocanasaṅkalpavyavasāyalakṣaṇena phalāvasānaliṅgenāvagamyate -- asti hi śrotrādibhirasaṃhataḥ yatprayojanaprayuktaḥ śrotrādikalāpaḥ gṛhādivaditi| saṃhatānāṃ parārthatvādavagamyate śrotrādīnāṃ prayoktā tasmādanurūpamevedaṃ prativacanaṃ śrotrasya śrotramityādi| kaḥ punaratra padārthaḥ śrotrasya śrotramityādeḥ ? na hratra śrotrasya śrotrāntareṇārthaḥ, yathā prakāśasya prakāśāntareṇa| naiṣa dopaḥ| ayamatra padārthaḥ -- śrotraṃ tāvatsvaviṣayavyañjanasamarthaṃ ddaṣṭam| tattu svaviṣayavyañjanasāmathryaṃ śrotrasya caitanye hrātmajyotiṣi nitye'saṃhate sarvāntare sati bhavati, na asati iti ataḥ śrotrasya śrotramityādyupapadyate| tathā ca śrutyantarāṇi -- "ātmanaivāyaṃ jyotiṣāste" "tasya bhāsā sarvamidaṃ vibhāti" "yena sūryastapati tejaseddhaḥ" " ityādīni| yadādityagataṃ tejo jagadbhāsayate'khilam" "kṣetraṃ kṣetrī tathā kṛtsnaṃ prakāśayati bhārata" iti ca gītāsu| kāṭhake ca "nityo nityānāṃ cetanaścetanānām" iti śrotrādyeva sarvasyātmabhūtaṃ cetanamiti prasiddham ; tadiha nivatryate asti kimapi vidvadbuddhigamyaṃ sarvāntaratamaṃ kūṭasthamajamajaramamṛtamabhayaṃ śrotrāderapi śrotrādi tatsāmathryanimittam iti prativacanaṃ śabdārthaścopapadyata eva| tathā manasaḥ antaḥkaraṇasya manaḥ| na hrantaḥkaraṇam antareṇa caitanyajyotiṣo dīdhitīṃ svaviṣayasaṅkalpādhyavasāyādisamarthaṃ syāt| tasmānmanaso'pi mana iti| iha buddhimanasī ekīkṛtya nirdeśo manasa iti| yadvāco ha vācam ; yacchabdo yasmādarthe śrotrādibhiḥ sarvaiḥ sambadhyate -- yasmācchotrasya śrotram, yasmānmanaso mana ityevam| vāco ha vācamiti dvitīyā prathamātvena vipariṇamyate, prāṇasya prāṇa iti darśanāt| vāco ha vācamityetadanurodhena prāṇasya praṇamiti kasmād dvitīyaiva na kriyate ! na ;vahūnāmanurodhasya yuktatvāt| vācamityasya vāgityetāvadvaktavyaṃ sa u prāṇasya prāṇa iti śabdadvayānurodhena ; evaṃ hi bahūnāmanurodho yuktaḥ kṛtaḥ syāt| pṛṣṭaṃ ca vastu prathamayaiva nirdeṣṭuṃ yuktam| sa yastvayā pṛṣṭaḥ prāṇasya prāṇākhyavṛttiviśeṣasya prāṇaḥ tatkṛtaṃ hi prāṇasya prāṇanasāmathryam| na hrātmanānadhiṣṭhitasya prāṇanamupapadyate, "ko hrevānyātkaḥ prāṇyādyadeṣa ākāśa ānando na syāt" 'ūdhrvaṃ prāṇamunnayatyapānaṃ pratyagasyati' ityādi śrutibhyaḥ| ihāpi ca vakṣyate yena prāṇa ;praṇīyate tadeva brāhṛ tvaṃ viddhi iti| śrotrādīndriyaprastāve ghrāṇasyaiva grahaṇaṃ yuktaṃ na tu prāṇasya| satyamevam ; prāṇagrahaṇenaiva tu ghrāṇasya grahaṇaṃ kṛtameva manyate śrutiḥ| sarvasyaiva karaṇakalāpasya yadarthaprayuktā pravṛttiḥ, tadabrāhṛeti prakaraṇārthe vivakṣitaḥ| tathā cakṣuṣaścakṣūrūpaprakāśakasya cakṣuṣo yadrūpagrahaṇasāmathryaṃ tadātmacaitanyādhiṣṭhitasyaiva| ataḥ cakṣuṣaścakṣuḥ| praṣṭuḥ pṛṣṭasyārthasya jñātumiṣṭatvāt śrotrādeḥ śrotrādilakṣaṇaṃ yathoktaṃ brāhṛ 'jñātvā' ityadhyāhyiyate ; amṛtā bhavanti iti phalaśruteśca| jñānāddhyamṛtatvaṃ prāpyate| jñātvā vimucyate iti sāmathryāt| śrotādhikaraṇakalāpamujjhitvā -- śrotrādau hrātmabhāvaṃ kṛtvā, tadupādhiḥ san tadātmanā jāyate mriyate saṃsarati ca| ataḥ śrotrādeḥ śrotrādilakṣaṇaṃ brāhṛātmeti viditvā ; atimucya śrotrādyātmabhāvaṃ parityajya -- ye śrotrādyātmabhāvaḥ śakyaḥ parityaktum -- pretya vyāvṛtya asmāt lokāt putramitrakalatrabandhuṣu mamāhaṃbhāvasaṃvyavahāralakṣaṇāt, tyaktasarvaiṣaṇā bhūtvetyarthaḥ amṛtā amaraṇadharmāṇo bhavanti| "na karmaṇā na prajayā dhanena tyāgenaike amṛtatvamānaśuḥ" "parāñci khāni vyatṛṇatsvayambhūstasmāt parāṅpaśyati nāntarātman| kaściddhīraḥ pratyagātmānamaikṣadāvṛttacakṣuramṛtatvamicchan" "yadā sarve pramucyante kāmā ye'sya hmadi śritāḥ ... atra brāhṛ samaśnute" ityādi śrutibhyaḥ athavā, atimucyetyanenaivaiṣaṇātyāgasya siddhatvād asmāllokāt pretya asmāccharīrādapetya mṛtvetyarthaḥ||2|| yasmācchrotrāderapi śrotrādyātmabhūtaṃ brāhṛ, ataḥ -- na tatra cakṣurgacchati na vāggacchati no mano na vidmo na vijānīmo yathaitadanuśiṣyādanyadeva tadvi ditādatho aviditādadhi| iti śuśruma pūrveṣāṃ ye nastadvayācacakṣire||3|| na tatra takhinbrāhṛṇi cakṣuḥ gacchati, svātmani gamanāsambhavāt| tathā na vāg gacchati| vācā hi śabda uccāryamāṇo'bhidheyaṃ prakāśayati yadā, tadābhidheyaṃ prati vāggacchatītyucyate| tasya ca śabdasya tannirvartakasya ca karaṇasyātmā brāāhṛ| ato na vāggacchati yathāgnirdāhakaḥ prakāśakaścāpi san na hrātmānaṃ prakāśayati dahati vā, tadvat| no manaḥ manaścānyasya saṅkalpayitṛ adhyavāsāyitṛ ca sat nātmānaṃ saṅkalpayatyadhyavasyati ca, tasyāpi brāāhṛātmeti| indriyamanobhyāṃ hi vastuno vijñānam| tadagocaratvānna vidmaḥ tadbrāhṛ īddaśamiti| ato na vijānīmo yathā yena prakāreṇa etad brāhṛ anuśiṣyād upadiśecchiṣyāyetyabhiprāyaḥ| yaddhi karaṇagocaraṃ tadanyasmai upadeṣṭuṃ śakyaṃ jātiguṇakriyāviśeṣaṇaiḥ| na tajjātyādiviśeṣaṇavadbrāhṛ tasmādviṣamaṃ śiṣyānupadeśena pratyāyayayitumiti upadeśe tadarthagrahaṇe ca yatnātiśayayakartavyatāṃ darśayati| 'na vidmo na vijānimo yathaitadanuśiṣyat' iti atyantam evopadeśaprakārapratyākhyāne prāpte tadapavādo'yamucyate| satyamevaṃ pratyakṣādibhiḥ pramāṇairna paraḥ pratyāyayituṃ śakyaḥ; āgamena tu śakyata eva pratyāyayitumiti tadupadeśārthamāgamamāha -- anyadeva tadviditādatho aviditādadhīti| anyadeva pṛthageva tad yatprakṛtaṃ śrotrādīnāṃ śrotrādītyuktamaviṣayaśva teṣām; tad viditād anyadeva hi| viditaṃ nāma yadvidikriyayātiśayenāptaṃ vidikriyākarmabhūtaṃ kkacit kiñcitkasyacidviditaṃ syāditi| sarvameva vyākṛtaṃ viditameva; tasmādanyadevetyarthaḥ| aviditamajñātaṃ tarhiti prāpte āha -- atho api aviditād viditaviparītādavyākṛtāvidyālakṣaṇādvayākṛtabījāt, adhi iti uparyarthe, lakṣaṇayā anyad ityarthaḥ| yaddhi yasmādadhi upari bhavati, tattasmādanyaditi prasiddham| yadviditaṃ tadalpaṃ matryaṃ duḥkhātmakaṃ ceti heyam| tasmādviditādanyadbrāhṛ ityukte tvaheyatvamuktaṃ syāt| tathā aviditādadhi ityukte'nupādeyatvamuktaṃ tyāt| kāryārthaṃ hi kāraṇamanyadanyena upādīyate| ataśva na vedituḥ anyasmai prayojanāyānyadupādeyaṃ bhavatīti| evaṃ viditāviditābhyāmanyaditi heyopādeyapratiṣedhena svātmano'nanyatvād brāhṛviṣayā jijñāsā śiṣyasya nirvartitā syāt na hranyasya khātmano viditāviditābhyām anyatvaṃ vastunaḥ saṃbhavatītyātmā brāhṛotyeṣa vākyārthaḥ; "ayamātmā brāhṛ" "ya ātmāpahatapāpmā" "yatsākṣādaparokṣād brāhṛ" "ya ātmā sarvāntaraḥ" ityādiśrutyantarebhyaśceti| evaṃ sarvātmanaḥ sarvaviśeṣarahitasya cinmātrajyotiṣo brāhṛtvapratipādakasya vākyārthasya ācāryopadeśaparamparayā prāptatvamāha -- iti śuśrumetyādi| brāhṛ ca evamācāryopadeśaparamparayā evādhigantavyaṃ na tarkataḥ pravacanamedhābahuśrutatapoyajñādibhyaśca, iti evaṃ śuśruma śrutavanto vayaṃ pūrveṣām ācāryāṇāṃ vacanam; ye ācāryā naḥ asmabhyaṃ brāhṛ vyācacakṣire vyākhyātavantaḥ vispaṣṭaṃ kathitavantaḥ, teṣām ityarthaḥ| 'anyadeva tadviditādatho aviditādadhi' ityanena vākyena ātmā brāhṛeti pratipādite śroturāśaṅkā jātā -- kathaṃ nvātmā brāhṛ| ātmā hi nāmādhikṛtaḥ karmaṇyupāsane ca saṃsārī karmopāsanaṃ vā sādhanamanuṣṭhāya brāhṛādidevānsvargaṃ vā prāptumicchati| tattasmādanya upāsyo viṣṇurīśvara indraḥ prāṇo vā brāhṛ bhavitumarhati, na tvātmā; lokapratyayavirodhāt| yathānye tārkikā īśvarādanya ātmā ityācakṣate, tathā karmiṇo'muṃ yajāmuṃ yajetyanyā eva devatā upāsate| tasmādyuktaṃ yadviditamupāsyaṃ tadbrāhṛ bhavet, tato'nya upāsaka iti|
